svg.text: STT = ears, TTS = mouth, LLM = one possible brain. The only question each mode answers: who provides the brain, and where does the media run?
your prompt & config — nothing to run
↺ spoken reply played back to caller
whatever the mode, these never leave the Cloud
Vapi-style flagship — the agent is just a prompt + config.
Bring your own agent · your model, tools, memory
↺ spoken reply played back to caller
whatever the mode, these never leave the Cloud
Cloud does ears + mouth; your service is the brain. e.g. OpenClaw.
media stays on your servers · your LiveKit gateway
whatever the mode, these never leave the Cloud
You run the whole pipeline; Cloud keeps the control plane.
